name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  rubocop:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.0'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: bundle exec rubocop

  typescript:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Run TypeScript checks
        run: npm run tsc -- --noEmit

  graphql_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.0'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Run GraphQL lint
        run: bundle exec graphql-lint

  factory_bot_lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.0'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Run FactoryBot lint
        run: bundle exec factory_bot_rails linter

  rspec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:latest
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: vglist_development
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.0'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Configure database
        run: cp config/database.yml.ci config/database.yml
      - name: Run RSpec tests
        run: bundle exec rspec
      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
          fail_ci_if_error: true

  db_seed:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:latest
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: vglist_development
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.0'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bundle install --jobs 4 --retry 3
      - name: Configure database
        run: cp config/database.yml.ci config/database.yml
      - name: Run database migrations
        run: bundle exec rails db:migrate
      - name: Seed the database
        run: bundle exec rails db:seed
